title: プリンと盾琴
description:
Ta-daah!

I'm Cygnus, the Great Sage living at the edge of the forest!

One day, the demon lord suddenly appeared in the peaceful kingdom of Corvus!

The king and everyone else in the kingdom have all perished! What should we do!?

Ah! There's Sir Lyra!

Isn't that Sir Lyra, the loyal knight of the kingdom?

Let's defeat the demon lord together!

I have a secret weapon.

It's called the...

----

Pudding: Lyre Knight is the 13th title in the Katatema series, a unique and thrilling action-adventure of destruction!

Features:

* Minimal buttons! A simple control scheme.

* Deal with terrifying attacks easily using tools like the Happiness Ring!

* Designed to be fun and easy to play, even for those not skilled in shooting games.

* Collect items as you play and admire them in the collection room.

* A gradually unfolding world.

* A reliable companion always by your side.

* The music is all new tracks by Watson, and the soundtrack is also available.

----

You're welcome to stream this game.

Please avoid major spoilers in the thumbnails.
